claims.text: Periodicity-aware convolutional models do not transfer across datasets with mismatched dominant frequencies on ETTh1, Weather.
TimesNet is best characterised as 2D-convolutional periodicity-aware model.

evidence.description: Cross-dataset transfer from ETTh1 to ETTh1 yields worse MSE than training from scratch for TimesNet.

limitations.text: Distribution shift between train and test periods is not explicitly modelled.
Evaluation is restricted to public benchmarks and may not reflect production settings.

future_work.text: Investigating whether patching interacts with frequency-domain decomposition.
Pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer.
